fact: The 2027/28 Budget Strategy Paper directs medium-term budget support to a public-service digital and AI literacy programme, with no amount attached.

fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation officially began a cyber security training workshop for government officials, run with Tethics.

Lesotho News Agency reports a one-day training session for officers in Mohale's Hoek held by the Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation with LIPAM on technology use in ministries.
